topic: Shipping a Box at the Post Office

script.title: FRAGILE, HANDLE WITH CARE
script.story_hook: A sister's gift needs a careful send-off.
script.intro_zh: 一份送給姊姊的禮物，需要平安抵達。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today we ship a fragile box. Listen for size and cost words.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天我們到郵局寄易碎包裹。留意問尺寸與費用的句子。
script.outro: Box labeled, birthday saved. See you!
script.outro_zh: 包裹貼好標籤，生日救回來了。再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat each post office phrase.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在，逐句跟讀郵局裡的常用說法。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her thirties with wavy chestnut hair in a low ponytail, wearing an olive green puffer vest over a gray sweatshirt, black leggings and canvas slip-ons, average build, carrying a taped cardboard box
script.char_b_description: an older man in his fifties with close-cropped salt-and-pepper hair and round reading glasses, wearing a postal blue polo shirt, khaki shorts, gray socks with sandals and a canvas fanny pack, tall and relaxed

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! I need to ship this box to Texas.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid tə ʃɪp ðɪs bɑks tə ˈtɛksəz/
dialogue.zh: 你好！我要寄這個箱子到德州。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. What's inside, if I may ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ wʌts ɪnˈsaɪd ɪf aɪ meɪ æsk/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，容我問一下，裡面是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, a ceramic lamp. My sister's present.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ə səˈɹæmɪk læmp maɪ ˈsɪstɚz ˈpɹɛzənt/
dialogue.zh: 呃，一盞陶製檯燈，我姊姊的生日禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ceramic, then. Did you pack it well?
dialogue.phonetic: /səˈɹæmɪk ðɛn dɪd ju pækt ɪt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 是陶製品啊。那你包好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bubbles everywhere. Three layers, actually.
dialogue.zh: 包滿氣泡布，整整三層呢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three layers! You pack like a pro.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɹi ˈleɪɚz ju pæk laɪk ə pɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 三層！你包得像老手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I watched six videos last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ wɑtʃt sɪks ˈvɪdioʊz læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，我昨晚看了六個教學影片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wise. Now, do you need fragile labels?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪz naʊ du ju nid fɹædʒəl̩ ˈleɪbəlz/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。那，要貼易碎標籤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, please, on every side?
dialogue.zh: 要，麻煩每面都貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually two: top and one side.
dialogue.zh: 通常兩張：上面跟一個側面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Is there a scale? It feels heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɪz ðɛɹ ə skeɪl ɪt filz ˈhɛvi/
dialogue.zh: 好。有秤嗎？感覺好重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide it on the counter, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd ɪt ɑn ðə ˈkaʊntɚ ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 把它推上秤台，放這裡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighteen pounds. Wow, a heavy little lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪˈtin paʊndz waʊ ə ˈhɛvi ˈlɪtl̩ læmp/
dialogue.zh: 十八磅。哇，小燈怎麼這麼重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big lamp! Ground shipping is best for heavy boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ læmp ɡɹaʊnd ˈʃɪpɪŋ ɪz bɛst fɔɹ ˈhɛvi bɑksəz/
dialogue.zh: 大燈啊！陸運最適合重物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ground? How slow is slow, um...
dialogue.zh: 陸運？慢到什麼地步，呃……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four to six days across the country.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔɹ tə sɪks deɪz əˈkɹɔs ðə ˈkʌnˌstɹi/
dialogue.zh: 寄到全美國，大約四到六天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her birthday's in five days. Uh oh.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ ˈbɜɹθˌdeɪz ɪn faɪv deɪz ʌ oʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她生日只剩五天了。糟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then air. Two days, about ten extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɛɹ tu deɪz əˈbaʊt tɛn ˈɛkstɹə/
dialogue.zh: 那就空運。兩天，大概多十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten dollars buys a saved birthday?
dialogue.zh: 十塊錢，能救回一個生日？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually! I'd call it a bargain, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuʒuəli aɪd kɔl ɪt ə ˈbɑɹɡən ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 通常可以！說真的，太划算了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold. Air it is, please.
dialogue.zh: 成交。那就空運，麻煩你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done. Should we insure it too?
dialogue.zh: 好。要不要順便加個保險？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Insure? The lamp cost sixty dollars.
dialogue.zh: 保險？這盞燈才六十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then basic coverage fits. Five dollars.
dialogue.zh: 那就買最基礎的保障，五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breakage, or also theft?
dialogue.zh: 破損算，竊盜也賠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, and lost mail too.
dialogue.zh: 兩個都保，整包遺失也賠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, insured it is.
dialogue.zh: 好，那就加保。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Address? Your sister's, I guess.
dialogue.zh: 好。地址呢？寫你姊姊家吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's right here in my phone.
dialogue.zh: 就在我手機的備忘錄裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, Houston? That's zone two.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，休士頓？那是第二區喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the zone change the price?
dialogue.zh: 分區會影響價格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little. But air is flat, so no change.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtl̩ bʌt ɛɹz flæt soʊ noʊ tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 有一點。但空運是固定價，所以不會變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lucky me. Anything else I need?
dialogue.zh: 我真幸運。還需要別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a return label, if you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ə ɹɪˈtɜɹn ˈleɪbəl ɪf ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 要不要再貼一張退回標籤？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Return? Why would she send it back?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹɪˈtɜɹn waɪ wʊd ʃi sɛnd ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 退回？她幹嘛要寄回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If the lamp arrives cracked, no drama.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ðə læm əˈɹaɪvz kɹækt noʊ ˈdɹɑmə/
dialogue.zh: 萬一送到時破了，也好處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! She can ship the pieces home?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ʃi kæn ʃɪp ðə ˈpisəz hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 噢！她能把碎片寄回來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, and you'd file the insurance claim.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ænd ju d faɪl ðə ɪnˈʃʊɹəns kleɪm/
dialogue.zh: 對，到時候申請理賠就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clever. Add one, please.
dialogue.zh: 厲害。請幫我加一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Added. The total's twenty-eight sixty.
dialogue.zh: 加好了，總共二十八塊六。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cards okay, or cash only?
dialogue.zh: 刷卡可以，還是只能付現？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either works! Tap the green reader there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiðɚ wɜɹks tæp ðə ɡɹin ˈɹidɚ ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 都可以！碰一下那台綠色讀卡機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beep! Did it take my card?
dialogue.zh: 嗶！它有收到我的卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, approved. One second, printing.
dialogue.zh: 有，通過了。稍等，我在印單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your printer sounds like my old car.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈpɹɪntɚ saʊndz laɪk maɪ oʊld kɑɹ/
dialogue.zh: 你那印表機像我家的老車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! It works, and that's free.
dialogue.zh: 哈哈！能用就好，還不收錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free is my favorite word today.
dialogue.zh: 免費是我今天最愛的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's your receipt, and your tracking.
dialogue.zh: 這是收據，還有你的追蹤單號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the tracking number on it?
dialogue.zh: 追蹤單號在哪個位置？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top line. Save it in your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp laɪn seɪv ɪt ɪn jʊɹ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 最上面那行。存到你手機裡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Oh no... the sticky tape!
dialogue.zh: 好了。噢不……膠帶黏死了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What's wrong with the tape?
dialogue.zh: 膠帶怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's stuck to my sleeve. Forever.
dialogue.zh: 黏在我袖子上，撕也撕不下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, a box cutter. Snip, done.
dialogue.zh: 給你裁箱刀，一剪就開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Freedom! You're ready for anything, huh.
dialogue.zh: 自由了！你什麼都準備好了，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All paid and printed! Next customer? Ha!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl peɪd ænd ˈprɪntɪd nɛkst ˈkjuːstəməɚ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 錢付好、單也印好了！下一位？哈哈！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will she really get it by Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ʃi ˈɹili ɡɛt ɪt baɪ ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 她真的能在週五前收到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two days by air — I'd bet on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz baɪ ɛɹ aɪd bɛt ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 空運兩天就到，我敢跟你打賭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I believe you. Thanks so much!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ bɪˈliv ju θæŋks soʊ mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好，我信你。太感謝了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy shipping! Enjoy that lamp's trip.
dialogue.zh: 祝你寄件順利！讓那盞燈一路平安。

script.youtube_description:
60句郵局寄件聽力練習：一盞易碎的陶製檯燈，要趕在姊姊生日前從東岸送到德州，該怎麼寄？

這一集跟著一位提著紙箱的顧客，從問內容物、貼易碎標籤、上秤量重量，一路聽到陸運與空運的差別、保險承保什麼、退回標籤怎麼用，還有追蹤單號藏在收據哪裡。

你會聽到：
- 描述包裹內容與分量的句子
- 陸運、空運、保費的比較說法
- 保險承保範圍與理賠短句
- 單號、收據與小意外的應對

You will hear how to describe weight and contents, compare shipping speeds, and handle a funny tape mishap, then review every line with shadowing practice.

Made for A2 learners: no memorizing, just listen until it sticks.
